content.description:
Introducing LadSwag’s November Whiskey project, an exhilarating journey in the world of NFTs, featuring 716 exclusive battle card NFTs. These unique assets are designed for gameplay in the Cardano on-chain game, Trait Wars, offering both collectors and gamers an unparalleled experience.

The ‘Strategic Placement’ mission sets LadSwag apart with its distinctive offerings:

★ 1 Elite Gold Regiment : A special unit reflecting the artist Barney MC’s passion, providing exclusive insights on our Discord.

★ 10 Special Edition NFTs : Featuring iconic figures like Her Majesty the Queen, Winston Churchill, Ant Middleton, David Goggins, and other Cardano favourites, these NFTs are a tribute to legends.

★ 46 British Army Regiments : Each regiment is uniquely represented with its emblem and regimental pride, ensuring a diverse and rich collection.

★ 644 Enhanced Regiments : These regiments come with 14 distinct backgrounds, amplifying their uniqueness and appeal.

★ 15 British Army Badges : Symbolic tokens that embody the valour and ethos of the British Army regiments.

In a gesture of profound gratitude, we’ve expanded our roster to 717 NFTs, honouring the unwavering dedication of our 2iC and longest-standing Ambassador TD.

The November Whiskey project is not just an NFT collection; it’s a mission that intertwines history, honour, and artistic brilliance with the thrill of Trait Wars gameplay. Secure your piece of this exceptional project and be part of the LadSwag legacy.

Onward, to LadSwag’s November Whiskey!
